title: Indoor bike, aerobic flush, zero eccentric
coachNotes: The Thursday forecast improved after this session was written (21C, cloud, little rain rather than the washout ARPA implied on 17 Aug). It changes nothing. The reason this is a bike day is not the weather, it is the 1000m of descent 24 hours earlier after a 17-day eccentric gap, and ITB symptoms show up 24-48h after the descent that caused them, not during it. If Thursday is dry and you feel good, that is the day this plan is most likely to be broken, so it is being said in advance: do not convert this into a run. Bike because it buys aerobic minutes with no eccentric cost. Cadence high, resistance low, nothing that feels like a workout. Strength after: single-leg step-downs, glute med, Copenhagen. That is the actual training on this day. Garmin expect 50-80.
